  FROM (VALUES

    ('potassium_sparing', 904542), -- triamterene

    ('potassium_wasting', 932745), -- bumetanide
    ('potassium_wasting', 942350), -- torsemide
    ('potassium_wasting', 974166), -- hydrochlorothiazide
    ('potassium_wasting', 992590), -- chlorothiazide
    ('potassium_wasting', 1395058), -- chlorthalidone
    ('potassium_wasting', 907013), -- metolazone
    ('potassium_wasting', 978555) -- indapamide
  ) v(grp, ingredient_concept_id)
), ckd AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(condition_start_date) AS ckd_index_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_source_value IN ('N18.4','N18.5','585.4','585.5')
     OR condition_source_concept_id IN (35209277,35209278,44820970,44837192)
  GROUP BY person_id
), exposure_candidates AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date, ig.grp,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ig.grp='potassium_sparing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS has_sparing,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ig.grp='potassium_wasting' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS has_wasting
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  JOIN ingredient_groups ig ON ig.ingredient_concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
  JOIN ckd ON ckd.person_id = de.person_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date >= ckd.ckd_index_date
), exposures AS (
  SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date,
         CASE WHEN has_sparing=1 THEN 'potassium_sparing' ELSE 'potassium_wasting' END AS exposure_group
  FROM exposure_candidates
  WHERE (has_sparing=1 OR has_wasting=1)
  GROUP BY person_id, drug_exposure_start_date, has_sparing, has_wasting
), first_exposure AS (
  SELECT person_id, exposure_group, drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date
  FROM (
    SELECT person_id, exposure_group, drug_exposure_start_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id ORDER BY drug_exposure_start_date) AS rn
    FROM exposures
  ) x WHERE rn=1
)
SELECT exposure_group, COUNT(*) AS patients, MIN(index_date) AS first_index, MAX(index_date) AS last_index
FROM first_exposure
GROUP BY exposure_group
ORDER BY exposure_group;

WITH ingredient_groups AS (

         MAX(CASE WHEN ig.grp='potassium_wasting' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS has_wasting
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  JOIN ingredient_groups ig ON ig.ingredient_concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
  JOIN ckd ON ckd.person_id = de.person_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date >= ckd.ckd_index_date
), exposures AS (

         CASE WHEN has_sparing=1 THEN 'potassium_sparing' ELSE 'potassium_wasting' END AS exposure_group
  FROM exposure_candidates
  WHERE (has_sparing=1 OR has_wasting=1)
  GROUP BY person_id, drug_exposure_start_date, has_sparing, has_wasting

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id ORDER BY drug_exposure_start_date) AS rn

  ) x WHERE rn=1
), events AS (
  SELECT fe.person_id, fe.exposure_group,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id=3023103 AND m.value_as_number > 5.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hyperkalemia,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id IN (3015632,3016293,3006576) AND m.value_as_number < 22 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acidosis,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id=3023103 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_k_lab,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id IN (3015632,3016293,3006576) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_co2_lab
  FROM first_exposure fe
  LEFT JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.person_id=fe.person_id
    AND m.measurement_date >= fe.index_date
    AND m.measurement_date < DATEADD(day, 180, fe.index_date)
    AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
    AND ((m.measurement_concept_id=3023103 AND m.value_as_number BETWEEN 1 AND 10)

       CAST(100.0*SUM(hyperkalemia)/NULLIF(SUM(any_k_lab),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS hyperkalemia_rate_pct_with_lab,
       SUM(any_co2_lab) AS patients_with_co2_lab,

FROM events
GROUP BY exposure_group
ORDER BY exposure_group;
